context_notes.ati: Apparent thermal inertia (1 - albedo) / day-night LST range, 1/K. Relative index only; NOT comparable with Mars thermal inertia (tiu). Strongly affected by soil moisture. Null where |lat| > 60 deg or day-night range < 5 K.
context_notes.ati_class: Terciles over valid Earth cells: low < 0.0306 <= medium < 0.0362 <= high.
context_notes.albedo_shortwave: MODIS broadband (0.3-5 um) black-sky albedo; Mars uses OMEGA 1.08 um.

analysis.grid: 22 x 22, average-resampled in a local Transverse Mercator projection per cell
analysis.method: terrain_features() from prep/mars_prep.py (same code as Mars); steep threshold 15 deg; roughness sigma 1000 m. Mean wind speed: MERRA-2 SPEED, nearest grid point, day-weighted 2025 annual mean (lowest model layer).

eligibility.note: Excluded land-cover threshold is provisional. Cells are region centres, not verified access points.

sources.dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA / Airbus), AWS Open Data copernicus-dem-30m
MODIS MOD44B v061 Vegetation Continuous Fields (Percent_NonVegetated), mean 2022-2024
MODIS MCD12Q1 v061 Land Cover (LC_Type1, IGBP), mosaic of 2020-2025, newest on top
sources.used_for: eligibility: excluded land cover, barren fraction

sources.dataset: NASA MERRA-2 M2TMNXFLX (SPEED) and M2TMNXSLV (U10M, V10M, PS), monthly means 2025
sources.used_for: mean wind speed (scored, optional); wind direction and surface pressure (context)

sources.dataset: MODIS MOD11A2 v061 LST (day/night) and MCD43A3 v061 shortwave black-sky albedo, 2023
sources.used_for: context: surface temperatures, albedo, apparent thermal inertia (ATI)

sources.dataset: GLiM v1.1 global lithological map (Hartmann & Moosdorf 2012)
